mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_known_host (session_id, host, port, algorithm, fingerprint, public_key) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{host}, #{port}, #{algorithm}, #{fingerprint}, #{publicKey})
mapper.update: UPDATE operation_known_host SET algorithm = #{algorithm}, fingerprint = #{fingerprint}, public_key = #{publicKey}, trusted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND host = #{host} AND port = #{port}
